title: Hardware Garment 솔로 #019 · 하드웨어 카라비너 오버니 스타킹+가터 · orange/cobalt-blue · hourglass bombshell · 정면 팔 내림 · 배경 가을 단풍길 · 오네에갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail golden blonde hair — wearing a minimal runway set made entirely of small anodized aluminum carabiners clipped together in a tight grid, orange and cobalt-blue gates alternating: over-the-knee stockings of the same material held by small carabiners clipped end to end in a chain as garter straps to a high-cut panty-style bottom of the same material, and a top of two large diamonds of tiny carabiners clipped together in a tight grid, orange and cobalt-blue gates alternating, one over each side of her bust, each as wide as her palm and covering the middle of her bust fully while leaving the curve of her bust visible above, below and to the outside, with a bright anodized metal shine and tiny reflections on every gate, her stomach bare. Pose: standing tall facing the camera straight on, arms relaxed at her sides, weight even on both feet, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of anodized orange aluminum, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in anodized orange metal with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
